object_context: Let f:X→S be a smooth projective family of complex varieties, s0∈S, and α a flat rational cohomology class already algebraic on X_s0 via one fixed finite signed rational witness z0. Fix an irreducible local Hodge-locus branch through s0. Before seeking geometry forcing witness tangent surjectivity, H4d1c audits whether the target is the tangent space of the full Hodge-locus scheme or the reduced branch/support relevant to pointwise rational Hodge algebraicity. Initial algebraicity, higher Artin lifting, algebraization, monodromy/global continuation, and singular degeneration remain outside this atom.
structural_coordinates: exact root scope is rational cohomology on smooth projective complex varieties; this deformation lane assumes one already algebraic central witness
signed rational witnesses require coefficient-preserving finite multi-component Hilbert/Chow bookkeeping after denominator clearing
distinguish the Hodge-locus scheme T_sch, its reduction T_red, and the smooth locus T_red^sm
Zariski tangent vectors are dual-number infinitesimal directions; nilpotent scheme structure can enlarge tangent spaces without adding closed complex points
pointwise variational algebraicity is a statement about actual fibres/points on the Hodge support, not automatically about nilpotent infinitesimal thickening
a selected witness-incidence component need not contain every representative of the class; component switching and exact coefficient/category preservation remain explicit
proper/projective witness-incidence images are closed; domination of a dense open in an irreducible reduced branch is therefore a set-theoretic route to the whole reduced branch
surjective differential is only a local domination certificate under suitable smoothness hypotheses and is not demanded at singular/nonreduced points
full scheme-theoretic tangent surjectivity is a strictly stronger infinitesimal target unless reduced/smoothness or an explicit infinitesimal-strengthening goal is frozen
equivalent_formulations: root-aligned local target: every nearby complex point of T_red is reached by an exact-category algebraic witness representing α
geometric sufficient target: some exact coefficient-preserving proper witness-incidence component dominates the irreducible reduced Hodge branch
generic smooth-locus certificate: at a smooth point of source and T_red, a surjective differential can certify local dominance/open image
full T_{s0}T_sch surjectivity is a scheme-theoretic infinitesimal strengthening and is not equivalent to pointwise branch domination without additional hypotheses
solved_analogues: codimension-one Lefschetz (1,1): rational (1,1) classes are algebraic, providing a solved pointwise Hodge control
Dan's Noether-Lefschetz results: special variational Hodge loci are realized by flag-Hilbert images, while in the surface/divisor setting non-reduced Hodge-locus components occur
Kloosterman complete-intersection cycles on hypersurfaces: flag-Hilbert geometry plus tangent/dimension comparison proves a special variational Hodge result
near_solved_analogues: Buchweitz–Flenner and Pridham semiregularity/reduced obstruction theories
normal-function/infinitesimal-invariant approaches when coupled to an actual witness-reachability theorem rather than detector vanishing alone

explicit_disanalogies: H4d1c starts from an algebraic central witness and therefore cannot address the root initial-existence problem.
Divisor/Noether-Lefschetz controls are solved/special and cannot be generalized by analogy.
Set-theoretic domination of T_red does not imply lifting of nilpotent thickenings or higher Artin orders.
A proper-image closure argument does not by itself preserve a selected witness component, rational coefficient vector, or monodromy branch.
Singular reduced branches can have tangent directions that do not represent integrable local arcs, so full tangent surjectivity is not a generic replacement for domination.
analogy_scan_notes: Nonmathematical analogies were not retained because they do not preserve scheme reduction, exact algebraic-cycle categories, rational coefficients, or Hodge-locus infinitesimal structure.
